hints.title: Timestamp Lookups
hints.text: Store each recorded timestamp and price in a dictionary to track corrections.

hints.title: Track Extremes with Dual Containers
hints.text: Maintain the latest timestamp alongside min and max tracking containers.

hints.title: Lazy Discard Strategy
hints.text: Discard outdated prices lazily when querying extremal values from the containers.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(log N) amortized per update, maximum, and minimum query
complexity.space: O(N) storing timestamps and priority structures
complexity.notes: Outdated price entries in priority structures are discarded lazily upon query.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-sorting prices on every update takes O(N log N) which leads to time out.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Lazy deletion inside priority structures avoids expensive O(N) removals.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should implement lazy eviction with dictionary validation.
